scope: Controlled copies of real Wikipedia passages, not full-article population accuracy. Eight dropped-sentence cases use original fi/sv counterparts and controlled English passage copies. Real source documents and native MariaDB retrieval are used.
classification_note: Rows group cases by planted error type; a source check can catch a wrong fact. False-flag controls are source-supported passages, mostly single-language; this does not measure multilingual clean-pair false-positive rate.
